title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E22 — Wherever We May Be
Stokely Carmichael, the revolutionary leader who created and promulgated the now historic cry of "Black Power.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E8 — Secrets
The son of George's boss bullies Webster into doing his schoolwork, or else the kid will tell his dad to fire George.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E9 — A Test of Characters
Webster's crafts instructor takes credit for Web's winning picture in a photo contest.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E10 — Freedom of the Press
Webster's article in the school paper exposes the personal problems of a teacher Katherine is counseling.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E11 — Seeing It Through
Webster feels guilty that his success as a dog-walker comes at the expense of his predecessor; and the expense of home repairs spurs Katherine to try to fix things herself.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E12 — Katherine the Brave
Katherine takes over the role of scout leader for Webster's scout troop. Another male leader doesn't like the idea of a woman scout leader. When an injury calls for quick thinking, Katherine comes to the rescue.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E2 — The Break-Up
Lisa decides it's time to "dump" Terrence and forbids Ray from hanging out with him, while Roger tries to pick which twin to "woo.".

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E3 — The Tutor
When a high school football star needs a tutor, Tamera pretends to be Tia so she can teach him a special lesson in "chemistry"!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E4 — History A La Cart
An embarrassing arrest from his college days comes back to haunt Ray, and Lisa turns an inheritance into a shopping spree.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E5 — Grandpa Campbell
When Ray's ne'er-do-well father comes for a visit, he turns the household upside-down -- and turns Tamera into a ruthless businesswoman!

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E6 — Twins Get Fired
When Tia becomes Tamera's new boss at Rocket Burger, they both learn a lesson in responsibility.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E20 — The Prom
Moesha’s date for the proms cancels at the last minute.  She goes unescorted and meets a handsome mysterious boy who disappears at midnight.  She tries to find him, but to no avail.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E18 — It Takes Two
Kim’s mother, Nikki, is re-entering a journey she started 18 years ago. With Dee’s help, she will be completing her education to receive a high school diploma.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E19 — Had To Be You
An old boyfriend of Andell’s comes back into her life and proposes to her.  Moesha tries to keep Andell and Moesha’s Uncle Bernie together before it’s too late.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E21 — Independence Day
It’s Moesha’s 18th birthday, and as a surprise, her family and friends unknowingly invite all of Moesha’s past boyfriends to the party.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E22 — I Studied Twelve Years For This?
When Moesha’s car breaks down, she, Hakeem, and Niecy are late for their graduation ceremony.

S2 E22 — The Audit
Guest stars Red Buttons and Ron Glass appear in this unique 'Special Episode' of '227' which was videotaped only 24 hours prior to airing, enabling the characters to discuss late-breaking news items.

S3 E1 — My Aching Back
Mary and Sandra vie for a chance to deliver a line in a movie being shot at their building.

S3 E2 — The Talk Show
Sandra's show-biz career as a talk-show host threatens the friendship of the whole group when she questions them on the air about sex in the eighties.

S3 E3 — There Goes The Building
Rose receives an offer to buy her building from a real estate magnate whose plan to renovate means tearing down 227.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E14 — Whose Room Is It Anyway
An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E15 — Tough Love
Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E16 — A Decent Proposal
Nicolette enlists Malcolm and Eddie to convince her boyfriend to propose.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E17 — Bachelor Daze
A friend's upcoming wedding cause Malcolm and Eddie to reexamine their feelings about the women in their own lives.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E18 — Mixed Nuts
A surprise birthday party for Malcolm's dad sets the Shermans and McGees to fighting.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E2 — Happy Birthday, Pop
Fred's 65th birthday is anything but happy when his first Social Security check and Lamont's 'night on the town' don't meet his expectations.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E22 — Uncle George And Aunt Louise
Louise makes it very clear to George that she doesn't want another child in the house, but he makes sure she gets one anyway, and he lives to regret it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E23 — George And Louise In A Bind
A burglar ties up George and Louise and gives them a night to remember in a special 90-minute episode. As they wait to be rescued, George and Louise re-live (by flashback) some of their most unforgettable and hilarious experiences.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E26 — Jenny's Thesis
Jenny Jefferson's thesis research on street gangs teaches her and her family a horrifying lesson in life...and death.
